name: jev-wrapped
description: Telegram channel X-ray: paste a public channel, Jev judges a year of posts, you get a card. One Cloudflare Worker on the free plan.
author: Ivan Habor

scripts.dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply jev-wrapped --local && wrangler dev --port ${PORT:-5190} --var WRAPPED_DAILY_LIMIT:0 --var WRAPPED_DAILY_BUDGET_USD:0
scripts.deploy: wrangler d1 migrations apply jev-wrapped --remote && wrangler deploy
